convert_ase_atoms_to_atomicdata: convert an ASE Atoms object to an AtomicData graph with neighbor edges and cutoff radius
convert_ase_atoms_without_edges: convert an ASE Atoms object to AtomicData without computing neighbor edges for inference
convert_molecule_with_cell: convert a molecule to AtomicData by creating a periodic box with a specified cell size
